blocks.text: [Updated Sept. 17, 2026, 8:04 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Rodante Marcoleta’s press conference on Thursday was well within what is being allowed by the Sandiganbayan. The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) said the forum between the senator and reporters today inside the premises of the anti-graft court was alright with the justices. “The BJMP is simply implementing the directives of the Sandiganbayan,” BJMP spokesman Jail Superintendent Jayrex Bustinera said in a text message.
